en.greeting: Hi again! Today we count all the way to 100, then use numbers for your age, your phone number and prices in rupiah. Let's go step by step.

steps.title: Counting in tens
steps.text: You already know 1 to 20. Let's count in tens.
steps.body: The tens all end in **-ty**: twenty, thirty, forty… For the numbers in between, say the ten and then the unit: **twenty-one**, **fifty-six**, **ninety-nine** (with a hyphen in writing). After ninety-nine comes **one hundred**. Watch the spelling: **forty** has no u.

steps.title: thirTEEN or THIRty?
steps.text: These pairs sound almost the same. The secret is the stress.
steps.body: **-teen** numbers (13–19) are stressed at the **end**: thir**TEEN**, four**TEEN**, fif**TEEN**. **-ty** numbers are stressed at the **start**: **THIR**ty, **FOR**ty, **FIF**ty. Play each tile and listen for the strong part. Not sure what you heard? Ask: **One-three or three-zero?**

steps.title: Listen
steps.text: Press play and listen for the stress: start or end?

question.prompt: Listen. Which number do you hear?
question.explanation: You heard **FIF**ty — the stress is at the start, so it is 50. **fifTEEN** (15) has the stress at the end, and 55 is **fifty-five**.

steps.title: Your age and phone number
steps.text: Now let's talk about you: your age and your number.
steps.body: For age, say **I'm** + the number. You can add **years old**. English doesn't use *have* for age, so never 'I have 25 years'. Read phone numbers **one digit at a time**, in small groups with a pause. Say 0 as **oh** or **zero**, and 55 can be **double five**.

steps.title: Build the sentence
steps.text: Put the words in English order. Remember: age uses I'm, not have.

question.prompt: Arrange the words: Umur saya dua puluh tiga tahun.
question.explanation: Age is **I'm** (I am) + the number + **years old**. English doesn't use *have* here, so not 'I have twenty-three years'.

steps.title: Listen
steps.text: Phone numbers come fast. Listen for each digit in each group.

question.prompt: Listen. Which phone number do you hear?
question.explanation: The speaker reads one digit at a time in three groups: oh-eight-seven-seven, three-oh-one-five, two-two-six-eight. Small groups make a long number easy to follow.

steps.title: Prices in rupiah
steps.text: Time to go shopping!
steps.body: Say how many **thousand**, then **rupiah**: Rp25.000 = **twenty-five thousand rupiah**. After a number, **thousand** and **hundred** never take -s, and **rupiah** has no -s. English writes **25,000** with a comma; Indonesian writes 25.000 with a dot. Ask **How much is it?** and answer **It's … rupiah.**

steps.title: At the warung
steps.text: Read these out loud. Say the price in words each time.

examples.en: How much is the iced tea? — It's 5,000 rupiah.

steps.title: Your turn
steps.text: Look closely at the word thousand.

question.prompt: How do you say Rp20.000 in English?
question.explanation: After a number, **thousand** has no -s: twenty **thousand**. 'Two thousand' is only Rp2.000.

steps.title: Listen
steps.text: You're at a shop. Listen to the price.

question.prompt: Listen to the shop assistant. How much is it?
question.explanation: You heard **SIX**ty thousand — the stress is at the start, so it is 60,000. Sixteen thousand would be six**TEEN** thousand, and 6,000 is just six thousand.

steps.title: Cheat sheet
steps.text: Here is a cheat sheet you can keep and look back at.

artifact.title: Cheat sheet · Numbers & prices
artifact.intro: The tens end in -ty. Ages use I'm. Phone numbers go digit by digit. Prices: number + thousand + rupiah.
tips: Prices: **twenty-five thousand rupiah** — no -s on thousand, and English writes 25,000 with a comma.

examples.en: How much is it? — It's 25,000 rupiah.

steps.title: Learn more
steps.text: Want more practice? These two short videos help with counting and with the teen/ty stress.

id.greeting: Hai lagi! Hari ini kita berhitung sampai 100, lalu memakai angka untuk umur, nomor telepon, dan harga dalam rupiah. Yuk, pelan-pelan saja.

steps.title: Berhitung per puluhan
steps.text: Kamu sudah tahu 1 sampai 20. Sekarang kita berhitung per puluhan.
steps.body: Semua puluhan berakhiran **-ty**: twenty, thirty, forty… Untuk angka di antaranya, sebut puluhannya lalu satuannya: **twenty-one**, **fifty-six**, **ninety-nine** (pakai tanda hubung saat menulis). Setelah ninety-nine ada **one hundred**. Perhatikan ejaannya: **forty** tanpa huruf u.

steps.title: thirTEEN atau THIRty?
steps.text: Pasangan ini bunyinya hampir sama. Kuncinya ada di tekanan.
steps.body: Angka **-teen** (13–19) ditekan di **akhir**: thir**TEEN**, four**TEEN**, fif**TEEN**. Angka **-ty** ditekan di **awal**: **THIR**ty, **FOR**ty, **FIF**ty. Putar tiap kartu dan dengarkan bagian yang paling kuat. Ragu dengan yang kamu dengar? Tanyakan: **One-three or three-zero?**

steps.title: Dengarkan
steps.text: Tekan putar dan dengarkan tekanannya: di awal atau di akhir?

question.prompt: Dengarkan. Angka berapa yang kamu dengar?
question.explanation: Yang kamu dengar **FIF**ty — tekanannya di awal, jadi 50. **fifTEEN** (15) ditekan di akhir, dan 55 adalah **fifty-five**.

steps.title: Umur dan nomor telepon
steps.text: Sekarang kita bicara tentang kamu: umur dan nomormu.
steps.body: Untuk umur, katakan **I'm** + angkanya. Boleh ditambah **years old**. Bahasa Inggris tidak memakai *have* untuk umur, jadi jangan bilang 'I have 25 years'. Baca nomor telepon **satu angka demi satu angka**, dalam kelompok kecil dengan jeda. Angka 0 dibaca **oh** atau **zero**, dan 55 boleh dibaca **double five**.

steps.title: Susun kalimatnya
steps.text: Susun kata-katanya sesuai urutan bahasa Inggris. Ingat: umur memakai I'm, bukan have.

question.prompt: Susun kata-katanya: Umur saya dua puluh tiga tahun.
question.explanation: Umur memakai **I'm** (I am) + angka + **years old**. Bahasa Inggris tidak memakai *have* di sini, jadi bukan 'I have twenty-three years'.

steps.title: Dengarkan
steps.text: Nomor telepon diucapkan cepat. Dengarkan tiap angka di tiap kelompok.

question.prompt: Dengarkan. Nomor telepon mana yang kamu dengar?
question.explanation: Pembicara membaca satu angka demi satu angka dalam tiga kelompok: oh-eight-seven-seven, three-oh-one-five, two-two-six-eight. Kelompok kecil membuat nomor panjang mudah diikuti.

steps.title: Harga dalam rupiah
steps.text: Saatnya belanja!
steps.body: Sebut berapa **thousand** (ribu), lalu **rupiah**: Rp25.000 = **twenty-five thousand rupiah**. Setelah angka, **thousand** dan **hundred** tidak pernah diberi -s, dan **rupiah** juga tanpa -s. Bahasa Inggris menulis **25,000** dengan koma; bahasa Indonesia menulis 25.000 dengan titik. Tanyakan **How much is it?** dan jawab **It's … rupiah.**

steps.title: Di warung
steps.text: Bacakan dengan suara keras. Sebut harganya dalam kata setiap kali.

examples.en: How much is the iced tea? — It's 5,000 rupiah.

steps.title: Giliranmu
steps.text: Perhatikan baik-baik kata thousand.

question.prompt: Bagaimana mengucapkan Rp20.000 dalam bahasa Inggris?
question.explanation: Setelah angka, **thousand** tidak diberi -s: twenty **thousand**. 'Two thousand' hanya Rp2.000.

steps.title: Dengarkan
steps.text: Kamu sedang di toko. Dengarkan harganya.

question.explanation: Yang kamu dengar **SIX**ty thousand — tekanannya di awal, jadi 60.000. Enam belas ribu diucapkan six**TEEN** thousand, dan 6.000 cukup six thousand.

steps.title: Ringkasan
steps.text: Ini ringkasan yang bisa kamu simpan dan buka lagi kapan saja.

artifact.title: Ringkasan · Angka & harga
artifact.intro: Puluhan berakhiran -ty. Umur memakai I'm. Nomor telepon dibaca per angka. Harga: angka + thousand + rupiah.
tips: Harga: **twenty-five thousand rupiah** — thousand tanpa -s, dan bahasa Inggris menulis 25,000 dengan koma.

examples.en: How much is it? — It's 25,000 rupiah.

steps.title: Belajar lebih lanjut
steps.text: Mau latihan lagi? Dua video pendek ini membantu berhitung dan melatih tekanan teen/ty.
